title: Weekly Abs
author: AN
desc: Transform your core with the **Weekly Abs** program, designed to sculpt and strengthen your midsection. Comprising two focused sessions, this bodyweight routine features essential exercises like Dead Bugs, Planks, and V-Ups that target your abs and enhance overall core stability. Each workout is crafted to challenge you with precise rep counts and timed holds, ensuring maximum engagement and results. Get ready to feel the burn and build a strong foundation for all your lifts! Do as often as you like and add weights as you develop.
